sources.entry: PicGo - Support for common cdn image hosting tool. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/Molunerfinn/PicGo)

summary.one_liner: PicGo is an open-source desktop image uploader (built with Electron) that uploads images to image hosts, copies the resulting link to the clipboard, and can be extended with plugins.
summary.what_it_does: PicGo uploads images to configured image hosts such as Qiniu, Tencent Cloud COS, UPYUN, Alibaba Cloud OSS, GitHub, SM.MS, and Imgur, and automatically copies the resulting link in formats such as Markdown, HTML, URL, or custom templates. Uploads can be triggered by drag and drop, clipboard paste, a global hotkey (Command+Shift+U on macOS, Ctrl+Shift+U on Windows/Linux), or the right-click context menu on macOS/Windows. The README says a plugin system adds hosts like AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, and MinIO, plus features such as compression, watermarking, and renaming. It also lists an HTTP API (v2.2.0+) for integrating with other tools, and official Agent Skills and a DeepSeek Harness plugin so AI agents can upload using the same configured hosts. The README names Obsidian, VS Code, Typora, Neovim, MarkText, and SiYuan as editors that can use it through native support or community plugins.
use_cases: upload images for a blog post and get the link automatically
paste screenshots into Markdown notes or docs
let an AI agent upload generated images to an image host
upload images to Qiniu, COS, OSS, GitHub, or Imgur from the desktop
migrate or compress images with plugins
how_to_run: Download a release from GitHub Releases, or install via Homebrew: brew install picgo --cask
Windows alternatives from the README: scoop bucket add extras && scoop install picgo, or choco install picgo
Development: git clone the repo, then install dependencies with pnpm
Run pnpm run dev for the dev workflow with hot reload
Build installers with pnpm run build; output goes to dist
notable: Plugin ecosystem for S3, R2, MinIO and other hosts, with Awesome-PicGo as a plugin index
Auto-copies the link to the clipboard after each upload
Official Agent Skills and DeepSeek Harness plugin let AI agents upload images
Packaged via Homebrew, Scoop, Chocolatey, AUR, and Nix
caveats: Tested only on macOS and Windows; Linux not fully tested
The project no longer adds new third-party image hosts by default; extras come through plugins
Dev mode can be unstable and may crash
